value.message: Cartwheels Gym Centre runs Tiny Gym (parent + child, up to 3.5 yrs) and Mini Gym (3.5+, toilet trained, no parent) - their site says, but fall day/time and fees sit behind their registration login. Their home page does say Term 2-4 registration opens Oct 15, so fall's already underway. Want me to call and get the details?
